description: Main class for a bank management system handling user interactions, menu navigation, and invoking other classes for account operations.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main class managing user interface and invoking account operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, starts the intro menu.

methods.name: intro
methods.description: Displays initial options for login or account creation.

methods.name: loginAcc
methods.description: Handles login process by invoking Login class.

methods.name: createAcc
methods.description: Handles account creation by invoking Creation class.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Displays user menu for account operations and handles user choices.

methods.name: balInquiry
methods.description: Performs balance inquiry via BalanceInquiry class.

methods.name: accDetails
methods.description: Displays account details via AccountDetails class.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Performs fund transfer via Transaction class.

methods.name: tranHistory
methods.description: Displays bank statement via BankStatement class.

methods.name: accClose
methods.description: Closes account and deletes user data via Deletion class.
